notes: Run of 2026-11-13. Five Registry stories read, all paywalled after the lede. 150 California (a listing), 555 California (an earnings-call rent figure) and 989 Post (a duplicate) are declined. The Tracy logistics sale is outside the city; the Colliers inventory story names addresses only in its sidebar.

findings.description: Morgan Stanley's Prime Property Fund is marketing 150 California Street, a 249,960 sq ft, 24-story Financial District tower completed in 2000.

citation.label: The Registry, “Morgan Stanley’s Prime Property Fund Puts 250,000 SQFT 150 California Street on the Market in San Francisco,” 13 November 2026

raw.text: Morgan Stanley's Prime Property Fund is marketing 150 California Street, a 249,960-square-foot, 24-story Financial District tower completed in 2000

publish.note: Declined: a listing is not an event at the building (the same call as 2120 Washington Street, hoodline 2026-11-11-hl-0004, and 736 Mission Street's prospective buyer). The sale, when it closes, is the entry.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 150 CALIFORNIA ST → parcel 0236019; sf-parcels has blklot 0236019 active, 150–150 CALIFORNIA; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 2000.

findings.description: Vornado told investors its 555 California Street complex signed 55,000 sq ft of leases at an average starting rent of $163 per sq ft, the highest in the property's history.

citation.label: The Registry, “Vornado’s 555 California Street Hits Record $163 Rents as AI Demand Lifts San Francisco Office Market,” 12 November 2026

raw.text: its Financial District complex signed 55,000 square feet of leases at an average starting rent of $163 per square foot, the highest in the property's history

publish.note: Fails the ten-year test: an average rent from a quarterly earnings call is a market statistic, not something that happened to the building, and it is reported for a multi-building complex without naming a tenant or a building.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 555 CALIFORNIA ST → parcel 0259026; sf-parcels has blklot 0259026 active, 555–555 CALIFORNIA; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1969.
